player_prompt.intro:
O oe o le Pulega {player_id} i se taaloga {num_rounds}-tausaga o le Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Laufaʻaga o lou faʻamoemoe o le maua o ni tausaga e mafai ona e maua.
I tausaga uma, tali ma tasi o: '[rock]', '[paper]', poʻo '[scissors]'.
E mafai foʻi ona e faʻaaoga '[r]', '[p]', poʻo '[s]' o se faʻaupuga faʻalelei.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move e leai se malamalama. Faʻaaoga [rock], [paper], poʻo [scissors].

game_action.selects: O le tagata taalo {player_id} e filifilia lana gaoioiga {move}.

message.round_win: Faaiʻuga o le taamilosaga: Manumalo tagata taaalo {winner}!

outcome.p0_wins: O le tagata taalo 0 na manumalo i le tele o taaloga!
outcome.p1_wins: O le tagata taalo muamua na manumalo i le tele o taaloga!
